generator.four_hour_grid: UTC, complete bars, no duplicate timestamps, setup decision after close and availability

ohlc_construction.volume: lognormal(base_by_asset, sigma=0.35) with shock multiplier when cluster active

generator.fees_slippage_capacity: Use frozen per_asset contract/model/capacity receipts from the baseline bundle; no synthetic zero-cost shortcut.
generator.execution: Reopen the generated role through the same setup producer, select controls outcome-blind, execute TradeLifecycleV5, reconcile the account-currency portfolio, and map through the same disposition contract.
generator.fixture_boundary: Synthetic source is DEVELOPMENT diagnostic input only; it cannot mint PIT, SHADOW, confirmation, activation, or trading evidence.

timeline.bar_grid: UTC epoch-aligned 1m bars; each 4h setup bar is 240 contiguous 1m bars
timeline.event_schedule: deterministic seeded 42-day cluster grid over the 3650-day timeline; cluster starts are at least 42 calendar days apart
timeline.control_schedule: one historical control window exactly 21 days before each event; for multi-event clusters the cloned prior setup state is shared by the declared asset pair, then the frozen selector chooses the eligible control rows
timeline.event_control_overlap: forbidden by scheduled [decision, decision+240h) intervals before any outcome is read
timeline.time_origin: 2020-01-01T00:00:00Z plus a deterministic seed-derived year offset; no current or future data is read
timeline.conditional_scope: CONDITIONALLY_ADEQUATE_FIXED_STAGE: 32 calendar clusters, 50 raw events, 50 raw controls; this measures evaluator behavior when the predeclared sample geometry is available and does not validate natural signal yield

raw_counts.episodes_per_replication_means: 50 raw treated events arranged as 14 singleton clusters plus 18 two-event clusters; 50 controls are additional counterfactual series
raw_counts.natural_yield_policy: Never drop an event/control because a later lifecycle is missing; count it as unresolved or insufficient and retain the reason.

setup_shock.treated_event_final_4h_return: -0.09 exactly before minute expansion; this is a predeclared mechanism fixture above the frozen <=-0.08 threshold
setup_shock.shock_profile: Each cluster clones the prior 31 completed 4h setup state into the declared event/control pair before adding a -9% treated or -4% control setup shock and its volume path. Future 1m OHLC is generated independently after both setup rows exist; selection still uses only setup fields.
setup_shock.eligible_event_requirement: The generated treated setup is required to satisfy the frozen baseline predicate; if it does not, the replication records a setup-generation failure and cannot be silently repaired.

cluster_geometry.event_block_assignment: 14 singleton clusters and 18 clusters with two events; the two-event clusters use BTC and ETH only, while singleton assets rotate round-robin over the eight declared assets
cluster_geometry.control_blocks: each event has one control exactly 21 days earlier; the control lifecycle ends before the event lifecycle begins, and selected same-asset windows cannot overlap
cluster_geometry.independent_unit: merge only actual event/control lifecycle intervals that overlap in market time or same-asset time; pair endpoints count as one paired observation, and an empty gap between endpoints is never an interval
cluster_geometry.target_units: 32 independent calendar clusters and 32 complete paired clusters are the predeclared conditional target; any missing unit is retained and makes that replication INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE

effect_definition.units: total log-return shift over the frozen 14400-minute lifecycle
effect_definition.application: For PLANTED_EDGE only, add the predeclared total shift linearly across post-decision minute log returns after the frozen setup and control selection inputs are materialized but before OHLC construction; the selector, controls, stops, costs and portfolio see only resulting OHLC. The NO_EDGE and PLANTED_EDGE effect=0 cells apply no shift.
effect_definition.direction: positive adverse-reversion benefit for the long fixed baseline after a qualifying downside shock
effect_definition.no_edge: NO_EDGE always uses 0.0 and never applies a predicate-dependent shift.

scenarios.description: Common shocks, asset noise and lifecycle clustering are independent of the frozen evaluator predicate; no planted relation.
The predeclared total post-decision log-return shift is applied before execution for positive effect cells; effect=0 is a null-check cell and has no power target.

replicate_seed_mapping.seed_stream: seed=base_seed + scenario_index*1000000 + effect_index*10000 + replicate_index; replicate_index is 0-based
replicate_seed_mapping.base_seed_assignment: replicate_index modulo 5 selects base_seed; all five streams are required before a cell is complete.

preflight_benchmark.evidence_use: performance, memory, and generator custody only; excluded from FPR, power, disposition and promotion statistics

resource_budget.execution: stream one replication/cell at a time; retain compact result rows and hashes, not bulk synthetic bars
resource_budget.expected_generated_minute_rows_note: Four cells × 50 replications × (50 treated + 50 control) lifecycle series × 14,400 minutes; 4h warmup rows are additional and are not used to lower the budget.

targets.power_acceptance: lower_wilson_95 >= 0.80 at PLANTED_EDGE effect cells 0.02 and 0.04; PLANTED_EDGE effect=0 is reported as a null-check only, never as a planted-power success.
targets.decision_rule: A replication is a success only when event and paired fixed-stage falsifiers both satisfy the frozen thresholds; missing paired units is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, never a zero.
targets.replication_denominator: All planned replications are in the denominator. A replication without 30 event and 30 paired units is not dropped or relabelled; it contributes no success and is separately counted as INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
targets.natural_vs_conditional: Report natural eligible/event/control/paired yields for every cell. A conditional adequate-sample sensitivity may be shown as a secondary descriptive quantity but cannot replace the all-replication decision denominator.
targets.sampling_disclosure: The 32-cluster/50-event geometry is deliberately constructed before outcomes to exercise the fixed evaluator. Natural eligible-event and accidental-opportunity yields are reported separately and cannot be inferred from this conditional benchmark.

disposition_rules.INVALID_EVIDENCE: source generation, role re-open, PIT boundary, or economic reconciliation fails
disposition_rules.COMPUTE_INCOMPLETE: predeclared cell/replication/budget is incomplete or resource limit aborts
disposition_rules.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: independent event or paired lifecycle units below 30, or uncertainty cannot be computed
disposition_rules.ECONOMIC_FAILURE: complete fixed-stage evidence fails the joint event/paired falsifier
disposition_rules.TARGET_UNMET: operating-characteristic point estimate does not meet its predeclared Wilson bound
disposition_rules.DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY: all complete outputs remain non-promotable regardless of measured target

reproducibility.economic_hash: hash frozen generator/spec/source identities, selected episodes, trades, cluster statistics and dispositions; exclude runtime/custody paths
reproducibility.custody_hash: retain executor JAR, build input, runtime, exposure attempt and observed_at separately
reproducibility.repeat_rule: rerun each complete cell with a new immutable output; compare economic hash before any interpretation
reproducibility.resume_rule: changed generator/evaluator/build identity or existing output collision fails closed.

decision_rule: A cell is reported from all 50 planned replications. NO_EDGE/0.0 uses the FPR Wilson upper bound. PLANTED_EDGE/0.02 and /0.04 use the power Wilson lower bound. Any incomplete or inadequate replication remains visible and prevents a claim of measured adequacy; all outputs remain DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY.
